implementation_summary: Data scope filtering is a 3D permission system that restricts what data users can see based on their role's module_permissions[module_code].data_scope setting. The implementation correctly handles: 1) Admin bypass (admins see everything), 2) own_only (user sees only records they created), 3) own_assigned (user sees records they created OR are assigned to), 4) team (user sees records from their department + own + assigned), 5) all (user sees everything in the module).
